defaultRouteSource: V4 synchronous Rust root entry selected by package.json for the supported native and browser hosts

sourceClosure.coverage: Repository source closure includes Rust crates, core Node/WASM/Python binding source and Node/WASM binding tests, TypeScript source, schemas, fixture/corpus inputs, builder/test scripts, metamodel compiler closure and authority evidence. The source-pinned installed replay script and package-verifier tests are included. The exact @libpg-query WASM package resource copied by build-postgresql.ts is separately SHA-256 pinned as an external input. Lockfiles/toolchain versions identify dependency and tool resolution; installed host runtimes/browser are reported by the replay receipt. The model metamodel and action identity generators run only in the private snapshot; transform records all changed generated inputs. Any non-fixed-point result is explicitly non-release.
